pages.en:
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 299. SHANGHAI.
September 19th 1930
3773
19 9. 30

My dear Martin,

I have received a telegram from Petrie
of which the following is a paraphrase:

"A White Russian refugee, VASILEVICH KIZHILIAK
"who entered India via Chitral in May last was
"detained in India for some time as it was
"thought that he might give useful information.
"As he is no longer required we are sending him
"to Shanghai in the hope that he may be able to
"obtain employment there. He left Bombay for
"Shanghai by s.s. 'Hakone Maru' September 14th
"travelling on an Identity Certificate issued by
"the District Magistrate here. I shall be
"grateful if you will inform the Commissioner of
"Police in Shanghai about him and do what you
"can to secure employment for him as warder or
"in some similar capacity. His description is
"as follows:- height about 6 ft, well built,
pages.zh:
英国驻上海总领事馆，
邮政信箱 299 号，上海。
1930 年 9 月 19 日
3773
19 9. 30

亲爱的马丁：

我收到皮特里（Petrie）发来的电报，其大意如下：

“一名白俄难民，瓦西列维奇·基日利亚克（VASILEVICH KIZHILIAK），
去年五月经吉德拉尔（Chitral）进入印度，曾在印度被拘留一段时间，因为
认为他可能提供有用情报。
鉴于已不再需要他，我们正将他送往上海，希望他能在那里
找到工作。他于 9 月 14 日乘坐‘箱根丸’号（s.s. 'Hakone Maru'）轮船从孟买启程前往
上海，持由本地地区行政长官签发的身份证明书旅行。如蒙您向上海警务处处长
通报他的情况，并尽力为他谋得狱警或类似职位的工作，我将不胜感激。他的体貌特征
如下：身高约 6 英尺，体格健壮，

pages.en:
"bullet shaped head, fair hair, blue gray eyes,
aged 35."

Would you be so kind as to pass this
information to the Officer in charge of recruiting
of Russian patrollers or Russian watchmen in case an
opportunity occurs of finding him employment when
he arrives.

Yours sincerely,
A.D.Blackburn

Capt. A. J. Martin,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai.
pages.zh:
“头型呈子弹状，金发，蓝灰色眼睛，
年龄 35 岁。”

能否请您将此信息转达给负责招募俄国巡捕或俄国看守的负责人，以便在他抵达时若有就业机会可予安排。

此致
敬礼，
A.D.布莱克本（A.D.Blackburn）

A. J. 马丁上尉，
警务处副总监，
上海。

pages.en:
C.3773.
（印：3773 14/10 30）
October 14, 30.

My dear Blackburn,

I regret that owing to
the fact that I was on leave until September 22,
your letter of September 19 giving particulars
of the White Russian Refugee, VASILEVICH PIZHNIAK,
has only just been brought to my notice.

I now write to inform you that
we shall be pleased to find employment, probably
as a watchman, for this man and should be glad
if you will refer him to Captain Kennedy on his
arrival in Shanghai.

Yours sincerely,
(Sd) R.M.J. Martin.

A.D. Blackburn, Esq.,
H.B.M's Consulate-General,
SHANGHAI.

（手写批注：CP/giv m）
pages.zh:
C.3773.
（印：3773 14/10 30）
1930 年 10 月 14 日。

亲爱的布莱克本：

很遗憾，由于我休假至 9 月 22 日才结束，
您 9 月 19 日来信详述白俄难民瓦西列维奇·皮日尼亚克（VASILEVICH PIZHNIAK）一事，
直至近日才呈阅到我处。

现致函告知，我们将乐意为此人安排工作，大概职位为看守，
如蒙您在他抵达上海时将其引荐给肯尼迪（Kennedy）上尉，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，
（签名）R.M.J.马丁。

A.D.布莱克本先生，
英王陛下驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

（手写批注：CP/giv m）
